concerns.text: FR-002 and US1 require calculating `response_time_variance` and `mean_delay` per Contributor Pair. Task T012a performs this calculation 'in-memory' but does not persist the result. Task T015a is the designated persistence step for `data/derived/timestamp_features.parquet` (required by Constitution Principle VI), but it is marked incomplete `[ ]`. Without a completed task to persist these metrics, downstream tasks (T021b, T035) cannot access the required data, leaving FR-002 and US1 unfulfillable.

SC-005 and FR-009 require validating the cohesion proxy against manual coding (ρ ≥ 0.5) or using a synthetic fallback. Task T023b (Validation & Halt) and T022c (Synthetic Fallback) are both marked incomplete `[ ]`. There is no completed task to generate the `validity_report.json` or handle the missing manual ground truth scenario, stalling the pipeline before analysis (US3) can proceed.

FR-007 requires Benjamini-Hochberg correction for stratified tests. Task T029 implements the correction logic, but Task T031 (Stratified Calculation) is incomplete `[ ]`. T031b (Merge Corrections) depends on T031's output (`stratified_results_temp.json`). Since T031 is not marked complete, the stratified results and corrected p-values cannot be generated, leaving FR-007 unfulfillable.

FR-005 and Plan Phase 3 Task 3.2 require a Primary Analysis using Hierarchical Linear Modeling (HLM). Task T035 implements this, but it is marked incomplete `[ ]`. It depends on T021b (pair sentiment) and T015a (pair metrics), both of which are also incomplete. No task is marked complete to perform the primary HLM analysis, leaving the core research question unaddressed.

FR-010 requires aggregating pair-level variances to a project-level metric using the median. Task T015 implements this aggregation to `data/derived/project_metrics.csv` but is marked incomplete `[ ]`. Without this task, the Secondary Analysis (T026/T027) cannot proceed, leaving FR-010 unfulfillable.

FR-001 requires filtering projects with insufficient data (< min_events). Task T014 implements this logic but is marked incomplete `[ ]`. It depends on T015a (pair metrics), which is also incomplete. No completed task exists to filter the dataset, leaving FR-001 unfulfillable.

FR-011 requires logging the exclusion rate for non-English text per project. Task T024 implements this but is marked incomplete `[ ]`. No completed task exists to generate `data/logs/exclusion_rate.json`, leaving FR-011 unfulfillable.
FR-008 requires a VIF check and halt-on-high-VIF logic. Task T028 implements this but is marked incomplete `[ ]`. No completed task exists to perform the VIF check, leaving FR-008 unfulfillable.

FR-006 requires generating a scatter plot with 95% CI. Task T031a generates these plots but is marked incomplete `[ ]`. No completed task exists to produce the visualization, leaving FR-006 unfulfillable.

FR-004 requires Spearman rank correlation. Task T026 implements this for secondary analysis, but T035 (Primary HLM) is the main analysis. While T026 is marked incomplete, there is no *other* completed task that performs the primary correlation analysis required by the spec's core research question (US3). The spec implies the HLM is the primary method, and T035 is incomplete.

FR-002 requires excluding bot events. Task T011 implements this but is marked `[X]` (complete). However, Task T010 (Fetch Loop Logic) which calls the ingestion is incomplete. While T011 is complete, the *execution* of the bot exclusion within the full pipeline (T010 -> T011) is blocked by T010's incomplete status. This is a dependency issue, but T011 itself is covered. Re-evaluating: T011 is complete, so FR-002's bot exclusion logic is covered. The issue is the pipeline flow. I will keep the focus on the missing *execution* tasks for the metrics.

FR-001 requires fetching candidates. Task T010a (Fetch Loop Logic) and T010 (Data Ingestion) are incomplete. No completed task exists to fetch the initial pool of candidates, leaving FR-001 unfulfillable.

FR-003 requires VADER sentiment analysis. Task T019 implements this but is marked `[X]` (complete). However, the aggregation to project-level (T020) is complete `[X]`, but the pair-level aggregation (T021b) is incomplete. The spec requires project-level scores (FR-003) which T020 covers. But US2 also requires pair-level sentiment for the HLM (Plan Phase 2). T021b is incomplete. The project-level requirement (FR-003) is covered by T020. I will remove this as a 'missing' concern for FR-003 specifically, but note the pair-level gap in T021b.

FR-009 requires multi-modal validation. Task T022a (Sampling), T022b (Manual Ingestion), T022c (Synthetic Fallback), and T023b (Validation) are all incomplete. No completed task exists to perform the validation step, leaving FR-009 unfulfillable.

FR-005 requires linear regression controlling for confounders. Task T027 implements this but is incomplete. No completed task exists for the secondary regression analysis, leaving FR-005 (secondary part) unfulfillable.
FR-007 requires stratified correlations. Task T031 (Stratified Calculation) is incomplete. No completed task exists to calculate stratified results, leaving FR-007 unfulfillable.
FR-008 requires VIF check. Task T028 is incomplete. No completed task exists, leaving FR-008 unfulfillable.
FR-006 requires visualization. Task T031a is incomplete. No completed task exists, leaving FR-006 unfulfillable.
FR-001 requires filtering insufficient data. Task T014 is incomplete. No completed task exists, leaving FR-001 unfulfillable.
